{{- /* Instructions shared by all coding agents, see docs/agents.md */ -}}
{{- $fragments := dict -}}
{{- range list .chezmoi.workingTree (joinPath .chezmoi.homeDir ".local/share/chezmoi") -}}
{{-   range glob (joinPath . "agents/[0-9]*.md") -}}
{{-     $_ := set $fragments (base .) . -}}
{{-   end -}}
{{- end -}}
<!-- Generated by chezmoi from the dotfiles repos' agents/[0-9]*.md, edit those instead -->
{{- range keys $fragments | sortAlpha }}
{{-   $path := get $fragments . }}

{{ include $path | replace "{dotfiles}" (dir (dir $path)) | trim }}
{{- end -}}
